newsitem.title: USA: G7 intention will become clear from markets-source.
newsitem.headline: G7 intention will become clear from markets-source.

text.p: The intention of the Group of Seven industrial nations regarding cooperation in the currency markets will become clear from action by monetary authorities of G7 countries, an international monetary source said on Sunday.
"The G7 intention will be clear if you look at actions by monetary authorities in currency markets," the source said in a briefing to a group of reporters.
The source also said that Japan's concern about excessive yen weakness was clearly reflected in the G7 statement.
The source said that Japan is satisfied with the G7 statement, which stipulated that "excess volatility and significant deviations from fundamentals are undesirable."
The source said concerns about recent currency movements among G7 nations was one of the major reasons for issuing the statement.
He said the meeting of G7 finance ministers and central bankers stressed the importance of preparing the agenda for an annual summit of the leaders of the G7 countries.
